title: 第9章 重修至先天境圆满第10章 陷阱
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
林清雪与李易约定半年后在青州林家订婚，便与父亲林峰乘坐飞舟离开了。
同行的还有姬良辰等人，只有王昆找借口留下了。
李易带着大包小包的药草，外加一只炉鼎，回到了李族，他要炼丹来加速修炼，尽快恢复到万法境。
“哥，你不是有储物戒吗？怎么用手提？”
李凡见李易提着一堆药草和一只丹鼎回到院落，露出惊讶之色。
“丢了。”
李易没有告诉母亲，弟弟和未婚妻，自己消失这三年去了哪里，也没有告诉他们，大师兄周元丰对自己的挖骨抽筋之仇。
他要自己去报仇雪恨。
刚刚林清雪送他储物戒，他也拒绝了，他失去的东西要自己拿回来。
“哥，这三年你去了哪里？我和娘亲都急死了。”
李凡像是跟屁虫一般跟在李易身后，问个不停。
李易一边半真半假地回复，一边开始炼丹。
给三大女帝充当炉鼎这三年，他获益匪浅，不仅习得上乘功法，还学会了无上炼丹之术，神奇制符之术，以及最近的无敌剑术，算是因祸得福。
现在他将炼制最强的聚气丹，借用丹药之力，冲击炼气圆满。
很快聚气丹炼成功了，品质很高，达到了极品宝丹级别，这已是炼气境所能达到的极限。
丹药品阶为灵丹，玄丹，宝丹，金丹，圣丹，道丹，帝丹，天丹，仙丹，越往上，功效也越强，所辅助的境界也越高。
例如帝丹，由于它所蕴含的能量太过庞大，低阶修士服用，会瞬间爆体而亡。
更高的天丹，仙丹更是如此。
“哥，你炼制的丹药闪闪发光，看起来好神异，一定品质很高。”
李凡一直守在李易身边观看整个炼丹过程，见李易炼丹如此厉害，心中对哥哥的崇拜更强烈了。

“还好，只达到了极品宝丹。”
李易淡淡一笑，神色平淡，他在玉衡女帝的指导下已经能炼制出金丹了，不过金丹需要体内的三昧真火来炼制，以他现在炼气三层的修为，无法做到。
“哥，你的炼丹水平在燕国已经是宗师水平了啊，若是去燕国都城发展，肯定会成为皇族王室的座上宾，升官发财。”
李凡瞠目结舌，他还以为这是极品灵丹呢，没想到是极品宝丹。
“燕国太小了，在荒域排名万名开外，在整个八域界更是不值一提，而在广袤的上界更是沧海一粟，微如尘沙，我的志向可不是成为皇族王室的座上宾。”
李易眼眸透着明亮的光芒，站起身来，仰望苍穹。
自从与三大女帝接触后，他才知道自己所处的世界都有多浩瀚，这天地有多神奇，仙人，天神都是真实存在的，他们强大到可以改天换日，逆转时空，不入轮回，长生不死。
李易曾经只想在燕国出人头地，现在却是想出去看看真正的修行界，见识那些无上天骄、禁忌大能，体验诸天万界的奇妙，这样也不枉来世间走一遭。
“上界？”
李凡诧异，他还是第一次听到这个词语。
李易给弟弟讲解了自己这三年所了解的天地。
自己所处世界叫做八域界，一共有天地玄黄，宇宙洪荒八域，每一域都辽阔无比，方圆长达亿万里，燕国便是荒域中的一个小国家。
而如此浩瀚的八域界，对上界来说只是下界的一个小位面，像这样的小位面，多达亿万。
只有达到破空境，渡劫飞升，才能进入上界。
当然。
除了渡劫飞升外，还有其他通道可以进入上界，不过都是上古世家，不朽皇族，或者上界仙门在下界的分部，才拥有的通道。
“这天地如此巨大吗，真是令我心驰神往啊，我要好好修炼，争取去万界的中心上界看看。”
李凡感叹，胸中豪气万丈。
下一刻，他的苦着脸道：“我都忘了自己无法修炼，只能淬体，而淬体最高也只能达到先天境，我注定无望去上界了。”
李易安慰道：“小凡，谁说淬体只能达到先天境，我得到了一门神魔炼体大法，修行到最高境界，可以像太古神魔一样强大，比炼气更强。”
content_en:
Lin Qingxue and Li Yi agreed to get engaged at the Lin family in Qingzhou half a year later, and left in a flying boat with their father Lin Feng.
Ji Liangchen and others were also traveling with them, but Wang Kun made excuses to stay.
Li Yi returned to the Li clan with large and small bags of medicinal herbs and a furnace cauldron. He wanted to make elixirs to speed up his cultivation and return to the Wanfa realm as soon as possible.
"Brother, don't you have a storage ring? How do you carry it?"
Li Fan looked surprised when he saw Li Yi returning to the courtyard carrying a bunch of herbs and an alchemy cauldron.
"Lost."
Li Yi did not tell his mother, brother and fiancée where he had been in the past three years, nor did he tell them about his elder brother Zhou Yuanfeng's grudge against him.
He wanted to take revenge himself.
Lin Qingxue just gave him a storage ring, but he also refused. He had to get back what he lost.
"Brother, where have you been in the past three years? My mother and I are so anxious."
Li Fan followed Li Yi like a follower and kept asking questions.
Li Yi replied half-truthfully while starting to refine the elixir.
He has benefited a lot from serving as the cauldron for the three empresses for three years. Not only has he learned superior techniques, but he has also learned the art of supreme alchemy, the art of making magical talismans, and most recently, the invincible swordsmanship, which is a blessing in disguise.
Now he will refine the strongest Qi Gathering Pill and use the power of the pill to achieve the perfection of Qi Refining.
Soon the Qi Gathering Pill was successfully refined, and the quality was very high, reaching the level of the best treasure pill. This was the limit that the Qi Refining Realm could achieve.
The levels of elixirs are spiritual elixir, mysterious elixir, treasure elixir, golden elixir, holy elixir, Tao elixir, imperial elixir, heaven elixir, and elixir elixir. The higher the level, the stronger the effect and the higher the realm it assists.
For example, the Imperial Pill contains so much energy that low-level monks will explode and die instantly if they take it.
This is especially true for higher heavenly elixirs and elixirs.
"Brother, the elixir you refined is sparkling and looks so magical. It must be of high quality."
Li Fan had been staying by Li Yi's side to watch the entire alchemy process. Seeing that Li Yi was so good at alchemy, his admiration for his brother became even stronger.
"Fortunately, I only reached the highest level of treasure elixir."
Li Yi smiled faintly with a dull expression. He had been able to refine the golden elixir under the guidance of Empress Yuheng, but the golden elixir needed the Samadhi True Fire in his body to refine it. With his current level of cultivation at the third level of Qi refining, he could not do it.
"Brother, your level of alchemy is already at the level of a master in the Yan Kingdom. If you go to the capital of the Yan Kingdom to develop, you will definitely become a guest of the royal family and be promoted and make a fortune."
Li Fan was stunned. He thought it was the best elixir, but he didn't expect it to be the best treasure elixir.
"The country of Yan is too small. It is ranked no more than ten thousand people in the wilderness, and it is not worth mentioning in the entire eight realms. In the vast upper world, it is just a drop in the ocean, as tiny as dust. My ambition is not to become a guest of the royal family."
Li Yi's eyes were filled with bright light, he stood up and looked up at the sky.
Since coming into contact with the three empresses, he has realized how vast the world he is in and how magical this world is. Immortals and gods are real. They are powerful enough to change the day, reverse time and space, avoid reincarnation, and live forever.
Li Yi once only wanted to make a name for himself in the Yan Kingdom, but now he wants to go out and see the real world of cultivation, meet those supreme geniuses, taboo powers, and experience the wonders of the heavens and worlds. This way, his trip to this world is not in vain.
"Upper realm?"
Li Fan was surprised. This was the first time he heard this word.
Li Yi explained to his younger brother the world he had learned about in the past three years.
The world he is in is called the Eight Realms. There are eight realms in the universe, including heaven and earth. Each realm is extremely vast, with a radius of hundreds of millions of miles. The Yan Kingdom is a small country in the wilderness.
And such a vast eight-realm world is just a small plane in the lower world to the upper world. There are hundreds of millions of small planes like this.
Only by reaching the Sky-Breaking Realm and transcending tribulations and ascending can one enter the upper realm.
certainly.
Except for crossing the tribulationOutside of Sheng, there are other channels to enter the upper world, but they are only owned by the ancient aristocratic families, the immortal royal family, or the branches of the upper world immortal sect in the lower world.
"Is this world so huge? It really fascinates me. I want to practice hard and try to go to the upper realm, the center of all realms."
Li Fan sighed, filled with pride.
The next moment, he said with a grimace: "I have forgotten that I cannot cultivate, I can only temper my body, and body tempering can only reach the innate realm at the highest level. I am destined to have no hope of going to the upper realm."
Li Yi consoled him: "Xiaofan, who said that body tempering can only reach the innate realm? I have obtained a body-refining method of gods and demons. After practicing to the highest realm, I can be as powerful as the ancient gods and demons, and stronger than refining Qi."
